items.requirement: Order, fill, and position history exports in a form suitable for audit and tax reporting
items.verified_by: a generated export over the paper period

items.requirement: Behaviour under broker outage and rejected orders has been exercised
items.verified_by: fault-injection record showing halt rather than retry

items.requirement: Broker positions, cash, and open orders are currently known and match local state
items.verified_by: a passing reconciliation report dated within the freshness bound

items.requirement: A capital-at-risk cap is set and enforced in code
items.verified_by: configuration plus the test proving a breach is refused

items.requirement: Modelled costs are validated against observed paper fills
items.verified_by: slippage and commission comparison over the paper period

items.requirement: Credentials are in the secret store only, with rotation recorded
items.verified_by: custody policy plus a negative test that environment credentials are refused

items.requirement: A deactivation and rollback procedure exists and has been exercised
Personal-trading and outside-activity policy has been reviewed and permits this activity
items.verified_by: dated attestation by the owner naming the policy reviewed

items.requirement: The kill switch stops submission within the declared bound
items.verified_by: kill-switch test record with measured latency

items.requirement: Applicable legal, regulatory, and tax obligations have been reviewed
items.verified_by: dated attestation by the owner naming the review performed

items.requirement: An operational rehearsal including a deliberate failure drill has been performed
items.verified_by: rehearsal record with injected failure and observed recovery

items.requirement: The owner has approved this deployment, naming the cap and the date
items.verified_by: written approval referencing every other item

items.requirement: Paper trading has run for the declared minimum duration with no gaps
items.verified_by: paper run records covering the whole interval

items.requirement: Paper results are stable across the evaluation period
A strategy holds a QUALIFIED_FOR_PAPER verdict under a frozen rubric
items.verified_by: qualification dossier with rubric identity and evidence hashes

items.requirement: Every reconciliation over the paper period passed with zero unexplained divergence
items.verified_by: reconciliation log across the paper period

items.requirement: Position, notional, drawdown, and daily-loss limits are enforced in code

policy: Every item is required. There is no score, no weighting, and no override; removing an item requires publishing a new checklist version.
